item.title: A Prayer of St. Francis of Assisi
item.description:
Simple Prayer for Peace Link to heading

Lord! Make me an instrument of thy peace -

Where there is hatred, let me sow love

Where there is injury, pardon

Where there is discord, union

Where there is doubt, faith

Where there is despair, hope

Where there is darkness, light

Where there is sadness, joy.

O Divine Master! Grant that I may not so much

Seek to be consoled, as to console

item.title: A Prayer to Recharge
item.description:
By Paramahansa Yogananda Link to heading

“Heavenly Father, it is Thou

Who dost directly sustain my body.

Awaken within me

Conscious will, conscious health,

Conscious vitality, conscious realization.

O Eternal Youth of body and mind!

Abide in me forever and forever”

item.title: Buddhir Balam
item.description:
The first prayer my mother taught me Link to heading

“Buddhir balam

Yasho dhairyam!

Nirbhayathvam

Arogatha!

Ajaatyam

Vaakpadudhvamsa

Hanumadh

Smaranaath bhaveth”

…

बुद्धि (buddhi) — intelligence, बलम् (balam) — strength, यश् (yash) — fame, धैर्यम् (dhairyam) — courage, निर्भयत्वम् (nirbhayatvam) — fearlessness, अरोगताम् (arogatAm) — disease-free health, अजाड्यम् (ajADyam) — determination, वाक् पटुत्वम् च​ (vAk paTutvam ca) — and articulateness of speech, will all last forever (भवेत्, bhavet) if you meditate (स्मरणात् , smaraNAt) on Lord Hanuman (हनुमत्, hanumat) at all times.

item.title: Ik Onkar
item.description:
Mool Mantar from the Japji Sahib Link to heading

There is One God!

He is the supreme truth

He, the Creator

Is without fear and without hate

He, the Omnipresent,

Pervades the universe.

He is not born,

Nor does he die to be born again.

By his grace,

shalt thou worship him

Before time itself

There was truth!

When time began to run its course

item.title: The Beatitudes
item.description:
Matthew 5:3–12 Link to heading

“Blessed are the poor in spirit,

for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

Blessed are they who mourn,

for they will be comforted.

Blessed are the meek,

for they will inherit the land.

Blessed are they who hunger and thirst for righteousness,

for they will be satisfied.

Blessed are the merciful,

for they will be shown mercy.

Blessed are the clean of heart,

item.title: Tvameva Mata
item.description:
Guru Shloka Link to heading

Tvam-Eva Maataa Ca Pitaa Tvam-Eva |

Tvam-Eva Bandhush-Ca Sakhaa Tvam-Eva |

Tvam-Eva Viidyaa Dravinnam Tvam-Eva |

Tvam-Eva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva ||

…

You Truly are my Mother And You Truly are my Father .

You Truly are my Relative And You Truly are my Friend.

You Truly are my Knowledge and You Truly are my Wealth.

You Truly are my All, My God of Gods.
